description: Oil and Gas' Location Meter Object Structure
title: LOCATIONMETER

plusgenvconmon.title: Environmental Consent Monitoring
plusgenvconmon.remarks: Indicates whether monitoring for environmental consents, such as monitoring the quality of emissions to air, is associated with the meter for this location.

active.title: Active
active.remarks: Is this location's meter available to accept manual or rolled down readings, or to be used in PM or CM work order generation?

plusgemissionimpact.title: Emission Impact
plusgemissionimpact.remarks: The impact of the emission such as fugitive or direct emission

metername.title: Meter
metername.remarks: Identifier for the meter attached to the location, for example HOURS or KILOMETERS.

plusgemissioncat.title: Emission Category
plusgemissioncat.remarks: The category of emission such as leak, spill or vent

plusgconsenttype.title: Consent Type
plusgconsenttype.remarks: The type of environmental consent, such as emissions to water, emissions to air, or energy usage.

location.title: Location
location.remarks: Location to which the meter is attached

cotwomeasureunitid.title: CO2 Measurement Unit
cotwomeasureunitid.remarks: The unit of measure such as kilograms or gallons

plusgemissiontype.title: Emission Type
plusgemissiontype.remarks: The type of emission such as emission to air, emission to ground
